protocol.universe: Binance archived USDT spot, top 40 by trailing 30 completed-day mean quote volume at signal close
protocol.history_requirement: 240 consecutive UTC candles, positive current volume, no known identity boundary inside window
protocol.model: unchanged v0.3.1 price-only Ridge, matured 28-day labels, 540-day rolling training, refit every 7 days
protocol.execution: signal D close observed D+1, fills earliest D+2 open; no retroactive same-open entry
protocol.missing_market: fail mode rejects held missing bars; zero mode writes off full cost basis after first missing/nontrading UTC day, no synthetic sale
protocol.folds: continuous 2019+ and independent calendar-year accounts; annual folds are NOT stitched into an investable equity curve
protocol.regime: prior-day BTC close vs SMA200 and trailing 28-day return: both positive=BULL, both negative=BEAR, otherwise TRANSITION
protocol.benchmark: BTC buy at same test-start open and liquidate same test-end close, same fee/slippage; no cash yield
protocol.tuning: no parameter search; fixed protocol before performance inspection
protocol.scope: historical walk-forward, archive-availability universe; incomplete listing notices; NOT untouched OOS, whole-market coverage or alpha approval

config.notes: All amounts and limits are virtual research defaults, not the user's capital mandate. Frozen before replay.
